component.name: njMule
component.summary: Next generation Java Mule: eD2K and Kad file sharing

description.p: njMule is a file sharing client for the eD2K and Kad networks, compatible with eMule. It searches servers and Kad, downloads from many sources while checking every part, shares files with credits and secure identification, and imports an existing eMule profile without changing it.

Its desktop window and its password-protected web interface show the same interface. It also works through SOCKS and HTTP proxies, follows a weekly schedule of its speed limits and opens its ports with UPnP, NAT-PMP or PCP.
